lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下個月各部門要一起去環島旅行，五天四夜，你報名了沒有？
lines.simplified: 下个月各部门要一起去环岛旅行，五天四夜，你报名了没有？
lines.pinyin: Xià ge yuè gè bùmén yào yìqǐ qù huándǎo lǚxíng, wǔ tiān sì yè, nǐ bàomíng le méiyǒu?
lines.english: Next month all the departments are going on a trip around the island together, five days and four nights. Have you signed up?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 去倒是想去，可是那幾天剛好是我們部門最忙的時候。
lines.simplified: 去倒是想去，可是那几天刚好是我们部门最忙的时候。
lines.pinyin: Qù dàoshì xiǎng qù, kěshì nà jǐ tiān gānghǎo shì wǒmen bùmén zuì máng de shíhòu.
lines.english: I'd like to go, all right, but those are exactly our department's busiest days.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 經理說行程有兩段，你可以只參加後面三天。
lines.simplified: 经理说行程有两段，你可以只参加后面三天。
lines.pinyin: Jīnglǐ shuō xíngchéng yǒu liǎng duàn, nǐ kěyǐ zhǐ cānjiā hòumiàn sān tiān.
lines.english: The manager says the itinerary is in two parts; you can join just the last three days.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這樣好了，我先去問我們經理，看看那三天能不能請假。
lines.simplified: 这样好了，我先去问我们经理，看看那三天能不能请假。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng hǎole, wǒ xiān qù wèn wǒmen jīnglǐ, kànkan nà sān tiān néng bù néng qǐngjià.
lines.english: Well then, I'll ask my manager first whether I can take those three days off.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的接下來會怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的接下来会怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de jiēxiàlái huì zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What will the man do next?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 跟大家走完五天的行程
choices.simplified: 跟大家走完五天的行程
choices.pinyin: Gēn dàjiā zǒu wán wǔ tiān de xíngchéng.
choices.english: Go on the whole five-day trip with everyone.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先看看能不能只去後三天
choices.simplified: 先看看能不能只去后三天
choices.pinyin: Xiān kànkan néng bù néng zhǐ qù hòu sān tiān.
choices.english: First see whether he can go for just the last three days.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yīnwèi bùmén tài máng, bú qù le.
choices.english: Not go, because his department is too busy.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 請經理幫他報名後三天
choices.simplified: 请经理帮他报名后三天
choices.pinyin: Qǐng jīnglǐ bāng tā bàomíng hòu sān tiān.
choices.english: Ask the manager to sign him up for the last three days.

questions.why: 去倒是想去，可是…… means he wants to go but has a problem (his department is busy). Once he hears he can join only the last three days, 這樣好了 brings a new plan: ask about leave first. The manager has already said he can join for three days, and the man only asks about taking leave.

focus.en: I do want to go, but…

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我叔叔家院子裡的樹開花了，這個星期六他請大家去喝茶，你也來吧？
lines.simplified: 我叔叔家院子里的树开花了，这个星期六他请大家去喝茶，你也来吧？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shúshu jiā yuànzi lǐ de shù kāihuā le, zhège xīngqíliù tā qǐng dàjiā qù hē chá, nǐ yě lái ba?
lines.english: The tree in my uncle's courtyard is in bloom. He's invited everyone over for tea this Saturday. Will you come too?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 想倒是想，可是我星期六得陪我阿姨去看房子，不知道要看多久。
lines.simplified: 想倒是想，可是我星期六得陪我阿姨去看房子，不知道要看多久。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎng dàoshì xiǎng, kěshì wǒ xīngqíliù děi péi wǒ āyí qù kàn fángzi, bù zhīdào yào kàn duōjiǔ.
lines.english: I'd like to, but on Saturday I have to go house-hunting with my aunt, and I don't know how long it will take.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 沒關係，我們下午兩點開始，一直到晚上都有人在。
lines.simplified: 没关系，我们下午两点开始，一直到晚上都有人在。
lines.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn kāishǐ, yìzhí dào wǎnshàng dōu yǒu rén zài.
lines.english: That's fine. We start at two in the afternoon, and people will be there right into the evening.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那好，我那邊一結束就過去，可能會晚一點到。
lines.simplified: 那好，我那边一结束就过去，可能会晚一点到。
lines.pinyin: Nà hǎo, wǒ nàbiān yì jiéshù jiù guòqù, kěnéng huì wǎn yìdiǎn dào.
lines.english: OK then, I'll come over as soon as I'm done there. I may be a bit late.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的星期六會怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的星期六会怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de xīngqíliù huì zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What will the man do on Saturday?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Liǎng diǎn zhǔnshí dào shúshu jiā.
choices.english: Be at the uncle's house at two on the dot.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dài āyí yìqǐ qù hē chá.
choices.english: Bring his aunt along to the tea.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bàn wán shì yǐhòu zài guòqù.
choices.english: Go over after he has finished his errand.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yào péi āyí, suǒyǐ bú qù le.
choices.english: Not go, because he is with his aunt.

questions.why: 想倒是想，可是…… first sounds like a polite no, but once he hears people will be there until evening he says 我那邊一結束就過去: he will come after the house viewing, probably late. Two o'clock is only when it starts, and he never offers to bring his aunt.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們本來打算星期六去海灘衝浪，可是新聞說那天會有颱風。
lines.simplified: 我们本来打算星期六去海滩冲浪，可是新闻说那天会有台风。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen běnlái dǎsuàn xīngqíliù qù hǎitān chōnglàng, kěshì xīnwén shuō nà tiān huì yǒu táifēng.
lines.english: We were planning to go surfing at the beach on Saturday, but the news says a typhoon is coming that day.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 既然這樣，就改去室內游泳池練游泳吧，衝浪下個月再去。
lines.simplified: 既然这样，就改去室内游泳池练游泳吧，冲浪下个月再去。
lines.pinyin: Jìrán zhèyàng, jiù gǎi qù shìnèi yóuyǒngchí liàn yóuyǒng ba, chōnglàng xià ge yuè zài qù.
lines.english: In that case, let's go and practise swimming at the indoor pool instead, and go surfing next month.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 颱風天游泳池大概也不會開。我看在家看電影就好了。
lines.simplified: 台风天游泳池大概也不会开。我看在家看电影就好了。
lines.pinyin: Táifēng tiān yóuyǒngchí dàgài yě bú huì kāi. Wǒ kàn zài jiā kàn diànyǐng jiù hǎole.
lines.english: The pool probably won't be open on a typhoon day either. I think watching a film at home will do.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 也好。那來我家吧，我剛買了一套音響，聲音很棒。
lines.simplified: 也好。那来我家吧，我刚买了一套音响，声音很棒。
lines.pinyin: Yěhǎo. Nà lái wǒ jiā ba, wǒ gāng mǎi le yí tào yīnxiǎng, shēngyīn hěn bàng.
lines.english: Fair enough. Come to my place, then. I just bought a stereo, and it sounds great.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們星期六最後會做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 他们星期六最后会做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen xīngqíliù zuìhòu huì zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What will they end up doing on Saturday?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhào jìhuà qù hǎitān chōnglàng.
choices.english: Go surfing at the beach as planned.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù shìnèi yóuyǒngchí yóuyǒng.
choices.english: Swim at the indoor pool.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dào nǚ de jiā kàn diànyǐng.
choices.english: Watch a film at the woman's place.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dào nán de jiā kàn diànyǐng.
choices.english: Watch a film at the man's place.

questions.why: 既然這樣 turns the typhoon news into his first new plan, the indoor pool. She points out the pool will be shut and suggests a film at home, and 也好。那來我家吧 settles it at his place. The woman suggests watching a film at home, and the invitation to his place comes from the man.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你嘴巴怎麼流血了？
lines.simplified: 你嘴巴怎么流血了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuǐba zěnme liúxiě le?
lines.english: Why is your mouth bleeding?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 剛才搶球時被打到牙齒。沒事，血快停了。
lines.simplified: 刚才抢球时被打到牙齿。没事，血快停了。
lines.pinyin: Gāngcái qiǎng qiú shí bèi dǎ dào yáchǐ. Méishì, xiě kuài tíng le.
lines.english: I got hit in the teeth when I went for the ball. I'm fine. The bleeding has almost stopped.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 既然受傷了，下半場就別上場了，我陪你去看醫生吧。
lines.simplified: 既然受伤了，下半场就别上场了，我陪你去看医生吧。
lines.pinyin: Jìrán shòushāng le, xià bàn chǎng jiù bié shàngchǎng le, wǒ péi nǐ qù kàn yīshēng ba.
lines.english: Since you're hurt, don't play the second half. I'll go to the doctor with you.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是我們只有五個球員，我不上場就不能比了。我先坐下來休息，等一下再看情況。
lines.simplified: 可是我们只有五个球员，我不上场就不能比了。我先坐下来休息，等一下再看情况。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì wǒmen zhǐyǒu wǔ ge qiúyuán, wǒ bù shàngchǎng jiù bùnéng bǐ le. Wǒ xiān zuò xiàlái xiūxí, děng yíxià zài kàn qíngkuàng.
lines.english: But our team only has five players. If I don't play, we can't go on. I'll sit down and rest first and see how it goes.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the man plan to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先休息再決定上不上場
choices.simplified: 先休息再决定上不上场
choices.pinyin: Xiān xiūxí zài juédìng shàng bú shàngchǎng.
choices.english: Rest first, then decide whether to play.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mǎshàng gēn nǚ de qù kàn yīshēng.
choices.english: Go to the doctor with the woman right away.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xià bàn chǎng yídìng jìxù shàngchǎng.
choices.english: Certainly play on in the second half.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bù bǐ le, ràng bǐsài tíng xiàlái.
choices.english: Stop playing and let the game end.

questions.why: She uses 既然受傷了 to argue that he should stop and see a doctor. He answers that the team needs him and he will rest first and see (等一下再看情況): he has not decided yet. The doctor is her idea, and he never says he will surely play.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳昨天不是要去河邊看煙火嗎？後來去了沒有？
lines.simplified: 你昨天不是要去河边看烟火吗？后来去了没有？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān bú shì yào qù hébiān kàn yānhuǒ ma? Hòulái qù le méiyǒu?
lines.english: Weren't you going to watch the fireworks by the river yesterday? Did you go in the end?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我正要出門的時候，我阿姨突然打電話來，說她已經到我家樓下了。
lines.simplified: 我正要出门的时候，我阿姨突然打电话来，说她已经到我家楼下了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng yào chūmén de shíhòu, wǒ āyí túrán dǎ diànhuà lái, shuō tā yǐjīng dào wǒ jiā lóuxià le.
lines.english: Just as I was about to leave, my aunt suddenly called to say she was already downstairs.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那你們就在家聊天了？
lines.simplified: 那你们就在家聊天了？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐmen jiù zài jiā liáotiān le?
lines.english: So you two stayed in and chatted?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 沒有，她就是來找我一起去的，還開車帶我去，比坐公車快多了。
lines.simplified: 没有，她就是来找我一起去的，还开车带我去，比坐公车快多了。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu, tā jiùshì lái zhǎo wǒ yìqǐ qù de, hái kāichē dài wǒ qù, bǐ zuò gōngchē kuài duō le.
lines.english: No, she came precisely to go with me, and she drove me there. Much faster than the bus.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的昨天晚上做了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的昨天晚上做了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuótiān wǎnshàng zuò le shénme?
prompt.english: What did the woman do last night?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gēn āyí zuò gōngchē qù hébiān.
choices.english: Took the bus to the river with her aunt.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài jiā lǐ péi āyí liáotiān.
choices.english: Stayed home chatting with her aunt.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zuò āyí de chē qù kàn yānhuǒ.
choices.english: Went to see the fireworks in her aunt's car.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yīnwèi āyí lái le jiù méi qù.
choices.english: Didn't go because her aunt came.

questions.why: 我正要出門的時候，我阿姨突然打電話來 sounds as if the plan was spoiled, and the man guesses they stayed in. But she says 沒有: her aunt came to go with her and drove her there. The bus is only what she compares the car with.

focus.en: just as I was about to…

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你今天怎麼這麼晚才到辦公室？大家都在等你開會。
lines.simplified: 你今天怎么这么晚才到办公室？大家都在等你开会。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān zěnme zhème wǎn cái dào bàngōngshì? Dàjiā dōu zài děng nǐ kāihuì.
lines.english: Why are you so late to the office today? Everyone is waiting for you to start the meeting.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對不起。我正準備出門，客人就打電話來說行程要改，我只好在家重新規劃一次。
lines.simplified: 对不起。我正准备出门，客人就打电话来说行程要改，我只好在家重新规划一次。
lines.pinyin: Duìbùqǐ. Wǒ zhèng zhǔnbèi chūmén, kèrén jiù dǎ diànhuà lái shuō xíngchéng yào gǎi, wǒ zhǐhǎo zài jiā chóngxīn guīhuà yí cì.
lines.english: Sorry. Just as I was getting ready to leave, a client called to say the itinerary had to change, so I had to replan it at home.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那現在都改好了嗎？
lines.simplified: 那现在都改好了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà xiànzài dōu gǎi hǎo le ma?
lines.english: So is it all sorted now?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 改好了。下午的參觀改到明天上午，等一下開會的時候，我再跟各部門說明。
lines.simplified: 改好了。下午的参观改到明天上午，等一下开会的时候，我再跟各部门说明。
lines.pinyin: Gǎi hǎo le. Xiàwǔ de cānguān gǎi dào míngtiān shàngwǔ, děng yíxià kāihuì de shíhòu, wǒ zài gēn gè bùmén shuōmíng.
lines.english: Yes. This afternoon's visit has moved to tomorrow morning. I'll explain it to all the departments in the meeting.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼晚到？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么晚到？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme wǎn dào?
prompt.english: Why was the man late?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Lùshàng pèngdào le kèrén.
choices.english: He ran into a client on the way.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài jiā děng kèrén dǎ diànhuà lái.
choices.english: He waited at home for a client to call.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zǎoshàng xiān dài kèrén qù cānguān.
choices.english: He took the clients on a visit this morning.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 出門前得先重新安排行程
choices.simplified: 出门前得先重新安排行程
choices.pinyin: Chūmén qián děi xiān chóngxīn ānpái xíngchéng.
choices.english: He had to rearrange the schedule before leaving.

questions.why: 我正準備出門，客人就打電話來: the call came just as he was leaving, and he stayed in to replan the itinerary (重新規劃). He did not sit waiting for the call, and the visit has been moved to tomorrow.

focus.en: just as I was getting ready to…

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這個星期天我們去海邊釣魚吧？釣魚的東西我都準備好了。
lines.simplified: 这个星期天我们去海边钓鱼吧？钓鱼的东西我都准备好了。
lines.pinyin: Zhège xīngqítiān wǒmen qù hǎibiān diàoyú ba? Diàoyú de dōngxi wǒ dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
lines.english: Let's go fishing by the sea this Sunday. I've got all the fishing gear ready.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 新聞說有一個颱風正往臺灣來，星期一才會到。可是萬一早一點到呢？
lines.simplified: 新闻说有一个台风正往台湾来，星期一才会到。可是万一早一点到呢？
lines.pinyin: Xīnwén shuō yǒu yí ge táifēng zhèng wǎng Táiwān lái, xīngqíyī cái huì dào. Kěshì wànyī zǎo yìdiǎn dào ne?
lines.english: The news says a typhoon is heading for Taiwan and won't arrive until Monday. But what if it comes earlier?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 應該不會那麼快吧。
lines.simplified: 应该不会那么快吧。
lines.pinyin: Yīnggāi bú huì nàme kuài ba.
lines.english: It shouldn't come that fast.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 海邊風一大就很危險。我們還是去室內釣魚場釣吧，那裡比較安全。
lines.simplified: 海边风一大就很危险。我们还是去室内钓鱼场钓吧，那里比较安全。
lines.pinyin: Hǎibiān fēng yí dà jiù hěn wéixiǎn. Wǒmen háishì qù shìnèi diàoyú chǎng diào ba, nàlǐ bǐjiào ānquán.
lines.english: The seaside gets dangerous as soon as the wind picks up. We'd better fish at an indoor fishing pond; it's safer there.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼想換地方？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么想换地方？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme xiǎng huàn dìfāng?
prompt.english: Why does the woman want to go somewhere else?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Pà táifēng zǎo yìdiǎn lái.
choices.english: She fears the typhoon may come early.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Diàoyú chǎng de yú bǐjiào duō.
choices.english: There are more fish at the fishing pond.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíyī cái yǒu shíjiān qù.
choices.english: She is only free on Monday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de hái méi zhǔnbèi dōngxi.
choices.english: The man hasn't got the gear ready.

lines.english: The music in these places is so loud that it sounds like noise. Some people get drunk, and some take drugs. Drugs harm body and mind, cause suffering for families, and can mean legal trouble if the police catch you.

lines.traditional: 各位家長好，歡迎帶孩子來參加我們的兒童戶外活動。這兩天的行程有爬山、在海灘玩水，還有學釣魚。下雨的時候，就改在室內上課。
lines.simplified: 各位家长好，欢迎带孩子来参加我们的儿童户外活动。这两天的行程有爬山、在海滩玩水，还有学钓鱼。下雨的时候，就改在室内上课。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi jiāzhǎng hǎo, huānyíng dài háizi lái cānjiā wǒmen de értóng hùwài huódòng. Zhè liǎng tiān de xíngchéng yǒu pá shān, zài hǎitān wán shuǐ, háiyǒu xué diàoyú. Xià yǔ de shíhòu, jiù gǎi zài shìnèi shàngkè.
lines.english: Good morning, parents, and welcome to our children's outdoor activities. Over these two days we'll go hiking, play in the water at the beach and learn to fish. If it rains, we'll have classes indoors instead.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 過去的活動中，有的孩子第一次嘗試下水時很怕，後來慢慢克服了怕水的障礙，敢玩水了。

lines.pinyin: Guòqù de huódòng zhōng, yǒude háizi dì yī cì chángshì xià shuǐ shí hěn pà, hòulái mànmàn kèfú le pà shuǐ de zhàng'ài, gǎn wán shuǐ le.
lines.english: At past events, some children were afraid the first time they tried going into the water. Little by little they overcame their fear of the water and felt able to play in the water.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 山上下午常常下大雨，所以我們不能不把爬山改到早上，第一天六點半就要出發。孩子們會一直流汗，請多帶一套衣服來換。

Qùnián wǒ gēn mèimei dōu shàng le dàxué, tā zǒngsuàn yǒu le zìjǐ de shíjiān, jiù cānjiā le shèqū de yuètuán, fùzé chànggē. Dì yī cì shàngtái qián, tā jǐnzhāng de chī bùxià fàn, shènzhì lián jiào dōu shuì bùhǎo. Biǎoyǎn shí, táixià de rén dōu hěn jīngyà. Tāmen yǐwéi tā zhǐ huì zài jiā chànggē, méixiǎngdào tā chànggē gēn gēxīng yíyàng hǎotīng. Yǐqián dōu shì péngyǒu yuē tā chūqù, xiànzài tā měi ge zhōumò dōu zhǔdòng zhǎo péngyǒu lái jiālǐ liàn gē, bǐ wǒmen hái máng.
passage.english: My mother loved singing when she was young and even sang in a restaurant, but after she married she gave up the time she used to spend practising singing so she could look after the family. Last year my sister and I both started university, and at last she had time of her own, so she joined a community band where she is the singer. Before she first went onstage she was so nervous she couldn't eat, and she couldn't even sleep. On the day of the show, the audience was surprised as soon as she started to sing. They thought she only sang at home, but her singing was as good as a pop star's. It used to be her friends who asked her out; now every weekend she is the one who invites friends home to practise singing, and she is busier than we are.

Yīshēng shuō, zhè zhǒng shēnghuó duì shēntǐ zhǐyǒu shānghài, tóutòng hái huì gèng yánzhòng. Chūyuàn hòu, shúshu bùdébù shǎo zuò yìdiǎn gōngzuò, zhōumò yě kāishǐ qù hǎibiān diàoyú. Tā cháng zuò zài hǎibiān kàn zhe shuǐ, yǒushíhòu děng le jǐ ge xiǎoshí, shénme dōu méi dài huí jiā. Búyòng jiē gōngzuò de diànhuà, tā juéde hěn zìyóuzìzài. Xiànzài tā měi ge yuè dōu dài wǒmen qù.
passage.english: My uncle is a manager at a big company. His schedule was full every day with meetings and client visits. He even had to watch the time at meals. One day last year, a client was already waiting for him at the office. Just as he was about to leave, his head suddenly began to hurt, and he ended up spending a week in hospital. The doctor said that living this way could only harm his health and make the headaches worse. After leaving hospital, my uncle had to work a little less, and he started going fishing by the sea on weekends. He often sits by the sea watching the water. Sometimes he waits for hours and takes nothing home. He feels free and easy when he doesn't have to take work calls. Now he takes us along every month.

text.traditional:
想嘗試刺激的戶外活動嗎？來海灘學衝浪吧！
上課時間：七月每個星期六、日上午八點到十一點
誰可以參加：滿十二歲可以報名衝浪課。還沒滿十二歲的兒童，請參加星期日下午的玩水課
不會游泳的人：上衝浪課以前，請先上一次室內游泳課（免費）
費用：一個人一千五百元（包括衝浪板）；三個人一起報名，每個人只要付三分之二
下雨或風太大的時候，課程改到下一個週末
上完課，招待每個人一杯果汁。也歡迎家長陪孩子一起學衝浪！

text.pinyin: Xiǎng chángshì cìjī de hùwài huódòng ma? Lái hǎitān xué chōnglàng ba! Shàngkè shíjiān: qī yuè měi ge xīngqíliù, rì shàngwǔ bā diǎn dào shíyī diǎn. Shéi kěyǐ cānjiā: mǎn shí'èr suì kěyǐ bàomíng chōnglàng kè. Hái méi mǎn shí'èr suì de értóng, qǐng cānjiā xīngqírì xiàwǔ de wánshuǐ kè. text.english:
Fancy trying an exciting outdoor activity? Come and learn to surf at the beach!
Classes: every Saturday and Sunday in July, 8:00–11:00 a.m.
Who: age 12 and over (children under 12, please join the Sunday afternoon water-play class)

text.traditional: 我是一個很怕時間不夠用的人。過去，我每天的行程都規劃得很仔細：幾點上課、幾點去補習、幾點吃飯，連走到捷運站要幾分幾秒都算好了。在朋友眼中，我分分秒秒都想著要怎麼安排時間。上個學期，我累得生了一場病，醫生說我的身心都需要好好休息。從那時候起，我每個星期留一天，除了必要的事，什麼都不排。剛開始，我實在不太適應，總是想拿出手機看看下一件事是什麼，花了一個月才改掉這個習慣。慢慢地，我發現沒有安排的日子也有不少樂趣：有時候去公園看人打球，有時候在咖啡店坐一個下午。以前我覺得休息就是犧牲念書的時間，現在我發現，休息過的第二天，書念得比以前更好。
text.simplified: 我是一个很怕时间不够用的人。过去，我每天的行程都规划得很仔细：几点上课、几点去补习、几点吃饭，连走到捷运站要几分几秒都算好了。在朋友眼中，我分分秒秒都想着要怎么安排时间。上个学期，我累得生了一场病，医生说我的身心都需要好好休息。从那时候起，我每个星期留一天，除了必要的事，什么都不排。刚开始，我实在不太适应，总是想拿出手机看看下一件事是什么，花了一个月才改掉这个习惯。慢慢地，我发现没有安排的日子也有不少乐趣：有时候去公园看人打球，有时候在咖啡店坐一个下午。以前我觉得休息就是牺牲念书的时间，现在我发现，休息过的第二天，书念得比以前更好。

Guòqù, wǒ měi tiān de xíngchéng dōu guīhuà de hěn zǐxì: jǐ diǎn shàngkè, jǐ diǎn qù bǔxí, jǐ diǎn chī fàn, lián zǒu dào jiéyùn zhàn yào jǐ fēn jǐ miǎo dōu suàn hǎo le. Zài péngyǒu yǎn zhōng, wǒ fēnfēn miǎomiǎo dōu xiǎng zhe yào zěnme ānpái shíjiān. Shàng ge xuéqí, wǒ lèi de shēng le yì chǎng bìng, yīshēng shuō wǒ de shēnxīn dōu xūyào hǎohǎo xiūxí. Cóng nà shíhòu qǐ, wǒ měi ge xīngqí liú yì tiān, chúle bìyào de shì, shénme dōu bù pái. Gāng kāishǐ, wǒ shízài bú tài shìyìng, zǒngshì xiǎng ná chū shǒujī kànkan xià yí jiàn shì shì shénme, huā le yí ge yuè cái gǎi diào zhège xíguàn. Mànmàn de, wǒ fāxiàn méiyǒu ānpái de rìzi yě yǒu bùshǎo lèqù: yǒushíhòu qù gōngyuán kàn rén dǎqiú, yǒushíhòu zài kāfēidiàn zuò yí ge xiàwǔ. Yǐqián wǒ juéde xiūxí jiùshì xīshēng niànshū de shíjiān, xiànzài wǒ fāxiàn, xiūxí guo de dì èr tiān, shū niàn de bǐ yǐqián gèng hǎo.
text.english: I'm someone who is always afraid of running out of time. In the past I planned every day's schedule in detail: when to go to class, when to go to cram school, when to eat; I even worked out how many minutes and seconds it took to walk to the MRT station. My friends thought I wanted to plan out every second of my day. Last semester I wore myself out and fell ill, and the doctor said my body and mind both needed a proper rest. Since then I keep one day a week on which I plan nothing but what is necessary. At first I really couldn't adjust: I kept wanting to take out my phone to see what came next, and it took me a month to break that habit. Slowly I found that days without plans have plenty of pleasures too: sometimes I go to the park to watch people play ball games, sometimes I sit in a café all afternoon. I used to think resting meant sacrificing study time. Now I find that on the day after a rest, my studying goes better than before.

text.traditional: 我家附近有一條老街。過去，那裡有十幾家酒吧和夜店，每天晚上都開到天亮。店裡的音響一開，街上都聽得到。這些噪音讓附近的民眾晚上睡不好。常常有人喝醉了在路上大叫，甚至有人在店裡吸毒，警察常常來抓人。附近的民眾不斷抱怨，很多有孩子的家庭都搬走了。三年前，新市長決定重新規劃這條街：店家晚上十二點以後不能再放音樂，沒有人住的房子拿來做兒童圖書館和休閒場所，週末還請小樂團在街上表演。現在，白天常常看到父母帶著孩子來散步，晚上也安靜多了，整條街的環境改善了很多，有一些搬走的人又搬了回來。不過，也有一些年輕人覺得很可惜，說這裡已經不夠酷了，晚上想跟朋友去喝一杯，得坐車到別的地方去。
text.simplified: 我家附近有一条老街。过去，那里有十几家酒吧和夜店，每天晚上都开到天亮。店里的音响一开，街上都听得到。这些噪音让附近的民众晚上睡不好。常常有人喝醉了在路上大叫，甚至有人在店里吸毒，警察常常来抓人。附近的民众不断抱怨，很多有孩子的家庭都搬走了。三年前，新市长决定重新规划这条街：店家晚上十二点以后不能再放音乐，没有人住的房子拿来做儿童图书馆和休闲场所，周末还请小乐团在街上表演。现在，白天常常看到父母带着孩子来散步，晚上也安静多了，整条街的环境改善了很多，有一些搬走的人又搬了回来。不过，也有一些年轻人觉得很可惜，说这里已经不够酷了，晚上想跟朋友去喝一杯，得坐车到别的地方去。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu yì tiáo lǎo jiē. Guòqù, nàlǐ yǒu shí jǐ jiā jiǔbā hé yèdiàn, měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu kāi dào tiān liàng. Diàn lǐ de yīnxiǎng yì kāi, jiēshàng dōu tīngdedào. Zhèxiē zàoyīn ràng fùjìn de mínzhòng wǎnshàng shuì bùhǎo. Chángcháng yǒu rén hē zuì le zài lùshàng dàjiào, shènzhì yǒu rén zài diàn lǐ xīdú, jǐngchá chángcháng lái zhuā rén. Fùjìn de mínzhòng búduàn bàoyuàn, hěn duō yǒu háizi de jiātíng dōu bān zǒu le. Sān nián qián, xīn shìzhǎng juédìng chóngxīn guīhuà zhè tiáo jiē: diànjiā wǎnshàng shí'èr diǎn yǐhòu bùnéng zài fàng yīnyuè, méiyǒu rén zhù de fángzi ná lái zuò értóng túshūguǎn hé xiūxián chǎngsuǒ, zhōumò hái qǐng xiǎo yuètuán zài jiēshàng biǎoyǎn. Xiànzài, báitiān chángcháng kàndào fùmǔ dài zhe háizi lái sànbù, wǎnshàng yě ānjìng duō le, zhěng tiáo jiē de huánjìng gǎishàn le hěn duō, yǒu yìxiē bān zǒu de rén yòu bān le huílái. Búguò, yě yǒu yìxiē niánqīng rén juéde hěn kěxí, shuō zhèlǐ yǐjīng búgòu kù le, wǎnshàng xiǎng gēn péngyǒu qù hē yì bēi, děi zuò chē dào biéde dìfāng qù.
text.english: There is an old street near my home. In the past it had a dozen or so bars and nightclubs that stayed open until dawn every night. When the clubs turned on their stereos, the music carried into the street. The noise kept nearby residents awake. Drunk people often shouted in the street, and some people even took drugs in the clubs, so the police often came to arrest people. Nearby residents kept complaining, and many families with children moved away. Three years ago the new mayor decided to replan the street: businesses could no longer play music after midnight, empty buildings turned into a children's library and places for leisure, and small bands invited to play in the street at weekends. Now you often see parents walking there with their children in the daytime, the nights are much quieter, the whole street is a far better place, and some of the families who left have moved back. But some young people think it's a pity: they say the place isn't cool any more, and if they want a drink with friends at night they have to take a bus or taxi somewhere else.

text.traditional: 上個月颱風過去以後，我跟幾個朋友去海邊玩。沒想到，海灘上到處都是被風吹來的東西：有樹枝、瓶子，甚至還有一台壞掉的冰箱。我們決定留下來整理。本來以為只有我們幾個人，一定要忙到天黑，沒想到附近的民眾聽說了，也一個一個主動來幫忙。大家不僅帶了手套，還有人開卡車來收垃圾。那天太陽很大，大家一直流汗，可是沒有一個人停下來休息。到了下午三點，海灘總算乾淨了。那天雖然沒有下水游泳，可是大家一起出力的感覺，比玩水還快樂。
text.simplified: 上个月台风过去以后，我跟几个朋友去海边玩。没想到，海滩上到处都是被风吹来的东西：有树枝、瓶子，甚至还有一台坏掉的冰箱。我们决定留下来整理。本来以为只有我们几个人，一定要忙到天黑，没想到附近的民众听说了，也一个一个主动来帮忙。大家不仅带了手套，还有人开卡车来收垃圾。那天太阳很大，大家一直流汗，可是没有一个人停下来休息。到了下午三点，海滩总算干净了。那天虽然没有下水游泳，可是大家一起出力的感觉，比玩水还快乐。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè táifēng guòqù yǐhòu, wǒ gēn jǐ ge péngyǒu qù hǎibiān wán. Méixiǎngdào, hǎitān shàng dàochù dōu shì bèi fēng chuī lái de dōngxi: yǒu shùzhī, píngzi, shènzhì háiyǒu yì tái huài diào de bīngxiāng. Wǒmen juédìng liú xiàlái zhěnglǐ. Běnlái yǐwéi zhǐyǒu wǒmen jǐ ge rén, yídìng yào máng dào tiān hēi, méixiǎngdào fùjìn de mínzhòng tīngshuō le, yě yí ge yí ge zhǔdòng lái bāngmáng. Dàjiā bùjǐn dài le shǒutào, háiyǒu rén kāi kǎchē lái shōu lèsè. Nà tiān tàiyáng hěn dà, dàjiā yìzhí liúhàn, kěshì méiyǒu yí ge rén tíng xiàlái xiūxí. Dào le xiàwǔ sān diǎn, hǎitān zǒngsuàn gānjìng le. Nà tiān suīrán méiyǒu xià shuǐ yóuyǒng, kěshì dàjiā yìqǐ chūlì de gǎnjué, bǐ wánshuǐ hái kuàilè.
text.english: Last month, after the typhoon had passed, I went to the seaside with a few friends. To our surprise, the beach was covered with things the wind had blown in: branches, bottles, even a broken fridge. We decided to stay and clean up. We thought it would be just the few of us and we'd surely be busy until dark, but people living nearby heard about it and came one after another to help without being asked. They not only brought gloves; someone even drove a truck over to collect the rubbish. The sun was strong that day, everyone sweated non-stop, but nobody stopped to rest. By three in the afternoon the beach was clean at last. We didn't go swimming that day, but working together felt even better than playing in the water.

text.traditional: 我的室友從小的夢想是當演員。他在學校學的是電腦，可是每天下課以後都去上表演課。為了付學費，他晚上還在超商打工，回到宿舍常常已經半夜了。我跟他說別這麼累，他說：「就算一天只能睡五個小時，我也要試試看。」他就這樣練了兩年。去年有一位導演來學校找演員，他也去試了，結果他得到了演小角色的機會。去看電影時，我們才發現他在電影裡只出現了三十秒，大家都很驚訝。可是他高興得不得了，買了很多張票請朋友去看。他說這三十秒可以說是他這輩子最珍貴的回憶，以後他還打算繼續努力，演更多的角色。
text.simplified: 我的室友从小的梦想是当演员。他在学校学的是电脑，可是每天下课以后都去上表演课。为了付学费，他晚上还在超商打工，回到宿舍常常已经半夜了。我跟他说别这么累，他说：「就算一天只能睡五个小时，我也要试试看。」他就这样练了两年。去年有一位导演来学校找演员，他也去试了，结果他得到了演小角色的机会。去看电影时，我们才发现他在电影里只出现了三十秒，大家都很惊讶。可是他高兴得不得了，买了很多张票请朋友去看。他说这三十秒可以说是他这辈子最珍贵的回忆，以后他还打算继续努力，演更多的角色。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de shìyǒu cóngxiǎo de mèngxiǎng shì dāng yǎnyuán. Tā zài xuéxiào xué de shì diànnǎo, kěshì měi tiān xiàkè yǐhòu dōu qù shàng biǎoyǎn kè. Wèile fù xuéfèi, tā wǎnshàng hái zài chāoshāng dǎgōng, huí dào sùshè chángcháng yǐjīng bànyè le. Wǒ gēn tā shuō bié zhème lèi, tā shuō: “Jiùsuàn yì tiān zhǐnéng shuì wǔ ge xiǎoshí, wǒ yě yào shìshi kàn.” Tā jiù zhèyàng liàn le liǎng nián. Qùnián yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn lái xuéxiào zhǎo yǎnyuán, tā yě qù shì le, jiéguǒ tā dédào le yǎn xiǎo jiǎosè de jīhuì. Qù kàn diànyǐng shí, wǒmen cái fāxiàn tā zài diànyǐng lǐ zhǐ chūxiàn le sānshí miǎo, dàjiā dōu hěn jīngyà. Kěshì tā gāoxìng de bùdéliǎo, mǎi le hěn duō zhāng piào qǐng péngyǒu qù kàn. Tā shuō zhè sānshí miǎo kěyǐshuō shì tā zhè bèizi zuì zhēnguì de huíyì, yǐhòu tā hái dǎsuàn jìxù nǔlì, yǎn gèng duō de jiǎosè.
text.english: My roommate's dream since childhood has been to be an actor. He studies computing, but every day after class he goes to acting lessons. To pay the fees he also works nights at a convenience store, and when he gets back to the dorm it's often already midnight. I urged him not to wear himself out like this, and he said, "Even if I can only sleep five hours a night, I want to give it a try." He kept at it like that for two years. Last year a director came to our school looking for actors; he tried out too, and as a result he was chosen for a small part. When we went to see the film, we found that he appeared on screen for only thirty seconds, and we were all surprised. But he was overjoyed and bought lots of tickets for his friends. He says those thirty seconds are probably the most precious memory of his life, and he plans to keep working hard and play more parts.
